scope: Frozen reproducible official snapshots for current and historical/suppressed Italian municipalities, the four-character Agenzia code needed by Codice Fiscale, and foreign-state codes. The partial local lookup retains suppressed identities and unavailable-code records; it must never imply complete historical birth-date validity. The pack remains fail-closed for a fully supported Codice Fiscale geography dependency because the official bulk sources contain explicit code gaps and the foreign historical bulk starts only in 1990.

liveOfficialBulkChecks.reason: The official metadata explicitly says COD_CATASTO is N.D. when unavailable. The live bulk contains 18 such rows spanning 16 distinct (PRO_COM_T, COMUNE) pairs, so it does not prove a complete historical/suppressed Comune-to-four-character-code mapping.

liveOfficialBulkChecks.reason: The official report is explicitly scoped from 1 January 1990 rather than the complete historical fiscal namespace, and COD_AT is empty when the Agenzia code is unavailable or unassigned.

liveOfficialBulkChecks.title: Archivio Comuni e Stati Esteri - Elenco Situazioni Attuali / point searches
liveOfficialBulkChecks.reason: ARCOM officially supports point searches for suppressed municipalities and foreign states, but the downloadable report menu exposes current-situation lists and requires a CAPTCHA. No reproducible versioned bulk historical/suppressed export was identified.

observedCoverage.currentMunicipalities: The pinned current ISTAT workbook exposes current stable territorial identifiers and the four-character alphanumeric municipality code, but it is a current-municipality snapshot.
observedCoverage.historicalMunicipalities: SITUAS report 128 is now a public official bulk list of suppressed/non-reconstituted municipalities from 1861 and exposes COD_CATASTO sourced from Agenzia delle Entrate. It returns 2,637 rows, but 18 rows spanning 16 distinct suppressed municipality identities still carry COD_CATASTO=ND.
observedCoverage.foreignStates: SITUAS report 469 is now a public official bulk historical foreign-state/territory list with COD_AT sourced from Agenzia delle Entrate, but its declared coverage begins on 1 January 1990. Of 262 rows, 239 have COD_AT and 23 do not; the historical entities Germania Ovest and Yemen del Nord are among the rows without a code.
observedCoverage.belfiore: Official bulk coverage is materially improved but still incomplete: 16 distinct suppressed municipalities in SITUAS report 128 have COD_CATASTO=ND, and no second authoritative versioned bulk source was found that fills those values without inference.

authoritativeCandidates.title: Archivio Comuni e Stati Esteri (ARCOM)
authoritativeCandidates.reason: The official service supports point searches, including suppressed entities, but no exact versioned bulk historical/suppressed artifact with reproducible complete coverage was found; current report exports are CAPTCHA-gated.

reason: Official public bulk coverage improved substantially: SITUAS now exposes suppressed municipalities with Agenzia-sourced COD_CATASTO and foreign states with Agenzia-sourced COD_AT. Ticket 115 still cannot be promoted because 16 distinct suppressed municipalities have COD_CATASTO=ND, the foreign historical bulk is explicitly scoped only from 1990, and ARCOM does not expose a reproducible complete historical/suppressed bulk export that closes those gaps. No missing code is inferred from names, successor entities, point queries or secondary datasets.
